text:
ben: hey everyone, I accepted the GitHub invite but my org access shows as 'Pending organization membership' and I can't see any private repos. trying to clone gives 403 via HTTPS and Permission denied via SSH.
olivia: did you accept with the same account that has your work email? sometimes people have forwarded aliases and GH considers it different
ben: accepted with ben+work@personalmail.com (we forward to ben@redwood.ai). gh shows me logged in as ben (personal).
people-ops: onboarding note: forwarded aliases can cause account mismatch. Can you check https://github.com/settings/emails and ensure ben@redwood.ai is added and verified?
ben: added redwood email as secondary but can't verify because verification email goes to the forwarded address and filter dropped it.
devops-bot: ci-bot: If SSO is required, you'll also need to Authorize SSO from the org page after verification.
sam: if you can't get the verification email, people-ops can re-send an invite directly to the verified work address or bump you into the team manually for immediate access.
ben: @people-ops can you resend to ben@redwood.ai directly? also, do I need to remove 2FA from my personal account? I have Authenticator on my phone for both accounts which is messy
people-ops: we'll resend the invite to ben@redwood.ai and add you to the engineering team temporarily. No need to remove 2FA. Just ensure you sign in with the work account when you accept and then click "Authorize SSO" on https://github.com/orgs/redwood. If you see 'Pending organization membership', try signing out and signing back in.
ben: got the new invite, accepted it while signed into work account, but still see SSO required and the "Authorize SSO" button is not visible in my normal browser.
olivia: browser extensions or old cookies can hide the button. Try incognito or a different browser. Also check that you're not accidentally signed into GitHub with the personal account in another tab.
ben: incognito worked — clicked "Authorize SSO" and redirected to Okta for approval. Approved. Now I can see the repo list.
devops-bot: deploy-bot: welcome @ben! tagging infra owners to confirm push perms. :rocket:
ben: cloned over SSH successfully and pushed a small test branch. `ssh -T git@github.com` shows the success message. thanks y'all.
people-ops: we'll update the onboarding doc: call out forwarded aliases, prefer adding work email as primary before accepting invites, and recommend incognito for first SSO authorize step. Filing a follow-up doc update ticket.
ben: left a short note in the onboarding channel with the exact steps so future folks with forwarding don't get stuck. thanks everyone!
